text:
The net production of ATP in glycolysis is 2 ATP per glucose. Substrate-level phosphorylation makes 4 ATP (at phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase, 2 each), and hexokinase and PFK-1 use 2 ATP. The team note is wrong: glucose costs 2 ATP to enter, giving a net of 2, and glycogen costs only 1 ATP (phosphorolysis gives glucose-1-phosphate), giving a net of 3.

CONFIDENCE: 97
